StaggerContainer is kept wrapping the grid for structural parity; because native StaggerContainer only injects delay into its DIRECT child (the grid wrapper) and the web relies on framer staggerChildren:0.06 propagating through the intervening grid <div>, each StaggerItem instead receives an EXPLICIT index*0.06s delay (local STAGGER_SECONDS = 0.06, matching the native StaggerContainer constant) to reproduce the staggered opacity 0->1 / translateY 15->0 entrance verbatim.

The web hook resolves currency symbol + precision from useSettings; with no ported native settings provider this uses the web default symbol '$' and honours the call-site precision ($<fmtNumber(amount,decimals)>).

L7 import { useSettings } from '@/hooks/useSettings' -> inlined local useSettings() shim returning the web default settings.gas_unit:'gallon' (the shipped web store default), so gasUnitLabel resolves to 'gal' exactly.
